Subject: Next steps: demo rotation + attendee gaps (proposed slots)

Hi Sophie / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to meet the Novacare team. Quick recap from our discovery: your main priorities are predictable inference latency for clinical routing, tighter cost controls across multi-tenant models, and a secure private deployment option for PHI-sensitive workflows. We captured a few technical constraints you mentioned (VPC peering, egress controls, and enterprise KMS) and will surface them in the walkthrough.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep dive where our infra lead walks through architecture, and Diego does a short demo of inference routing + KV-caching behavior with a sample workload. Two slot options below — please indicate which works or propose alternatives:

- Wed 8 Nov, 10:00–11:00 AM ET (preferred)
- Thu 9 Nov, 2:00–3:00 PM ET

Suggested attendees (please confirm who from Novacare will join):
- From Redwood: Evelyn (AM/ops owner), Ben (solutions engineer), Diego (platform engineer)
- From Novacare: product owner, infra/network lead, compliance/security (SOC2)

Logistics: we can run the session over Zoom (link provided after you confirm) or Google Meet if you prefer. I also attached a 1–page outline of the demo so your team can validate scope before the call.

Next actions: please reply with your preferred slot and the attendee names/titles. If you want a short pre-call with Rajiv or your infra lead to review firewall requirements, we can do a 15-minute sync 30 minutes before the deep dive.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | AM, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-demo-outline.pdf

Appreciate the clear recap. Thu 9 Nov, 2:00–3:00 PM ET works better for our infra lead (Rajiv) — Wed morning conflicts with a leadership offsite. Confirming attendees:

- Sophie Lang — Product (will attend)
- Rajiv Patel — Infra/network (will attend)
- Compliance: copying our security inbox (operations@novacare.com) to pull SOC2 artifacts if needed

A couple of asks up front:
1) Can you include a short agenda (10 min architecture, 25 min demo, 20 min Q&A + 5 min next steps)?
2) We’d prefer Zoom for screen sharing and recording.
3) Please include a brief SOC2 summary (control scope) in the attachments or a link so our compliance team can triage in advance.

If you can update with the confirmed Zoom link and send an invite, we’ll lock it. Also yes to the 15-minute pre-call 30 minutes prior — Rajiv will join if the time is available.

Best,
